page.layout: One printed title page, centred, one block of lines; an ornament (printer's woodcut) between the lines and the imprint; no notes. Digitiser's caption at the foot is left out.
page.notes: Printer's ornament (fruit and foliage woodcut) between the subtitle and the imprint, not transcribed. Imprint date in old form: CIↃ IↃ C LXV = MDCLXV (1665). Brown ink strokes and show-through on the page are not printed text. The first line of the title is "ARNOLDI GEVLINCX," with V as printed in the scan.
